title: Activon to exhibit at in-cosmetics Asia 2026, showcasing sustainable ingredients and exosome-based solutions
summary: Activon, a specialist in clean beauty ingredients, will participate in in-cosmetics Asia 2026, taking place from November 3 to 5 at the Bangkok International Trade & Exhibition Centre (BITEC) in Bangkok, Thailand
